name: XCC_BUDGET_MULTI_PERIOD_INT
description: This table is the open interface for you to load budget information into control budgets, with multiple periods for each row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION
columns.description: The source budget application for which this interface row is budgeted.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SOURCE_BUDGET
columns.description: The source budget name to which this interface row is budgeted.

columns.name: DATA_SET
columns.description: Set of records to be imported by the budget import process.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: The line number of the row. Unique within a given source_application, source_budget and data_set.

columns.name: BUDGET_YEAR
columns.description: The budget year for which the budget data is prepared.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency of the budget amount.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: The unit of measure used by this statitstical budget amount when the currency code is set as STAT.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: The budgeted General Ledger account, provided in a code combination identifier format. If the account is provided in both segment value format and code combination identifier format, then the code combination identifier format one will be ignored.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status of the row. Possible values are IN_PROCESS and FAILED. This column is for internal use only. Any user entered value will be ignored.
